code: if ((extent = (H5S_extent_t *)(H5O_MSG_SDSPACE->decode)(f, open_oh, ((flags & H5O_ATTR_FLAG_SPACE_SHARED) ? H5O_MSG_FLAG_SHARED : 0), ioflags, attr->shared->ds_size, p)) == NULL)
note: The input-controlled dataspace bytes are decoded into attr->shared->ds and later determine ds_size.
The decoded dataspace extent is converted to an element count used in the attribute data size calculation.
The product of input-derived dataspace element count and datatype size can overflow before being truncated into attr->shared->data_size; the missing obligation is that the product must fit in size_t.
The truncated attr->shared->data_size is used for the attribute data copy, causing the implementation to operate on an incorrectly sized buffer for the malformed attribute.
